mods.name: Custom Characters & Custom Attacks Pack
mods.author: Hyrule
mods.description: Playable Custom Forms (Mega Rayquaza, Primal Groudon, Primal Kyogre, Mega Mewtwo X, Ash-Greninja) complete with 10 signature custom attacks, 5 custom Ultimates, 3 custom Pokéball pickup items (vanilla icons, zero custom VFX assets), and drop-in ./characters/*.json support. Controlled by Hyrule's Mods -> Custom Characters Enabler.

mods.name: Gen 3-9 Regions & Levels Pack (14 Unique Maps)
mods.author: HyruleChosenOne
mods.description: Standalone custom levels pack adding all 7 Gen 3-9 regions (Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos, Alola, Galar, Paldea) with 2 distinct playable maps each (14 levels total), featuring unique terrain profiles, weather, sanctuaries, and 3D centerpiece landmarks. Works standalone or paired with National Dex Gen 3-9.

mods.name: Hyrule's Mods (QoL & Cheats Collection)
mods.author: HyruleChosenOne
mods.description: Offline Quality-of-Life, Enablers & Trainer Cheats collection by HyruleChosenOne: Custom Characters Enabler, Events Enabler (Choose-Mode Hub, preserving wallpaper and music), P2P Multiplayer (IP:Port), Main Menu Background & Music selector, Run Speed, Unlock All Difficulties, God Mode, Overdrive, Clean Menu, and Trainer Unlocks. Keep OFF for 1:1 Vanilla Offline Mode.

mods.name: Link (The Minish Cap) — Playable Character & Custom Attacks
mods.author: HyruleChosenOne
mods.description: Playable Link from The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap with full 8-direction animated sprites, Four Sword Red shiny variant, 5 authentic Minish Cap custom attacks (Picori Blade, Magical Boomerang, Gust Jar, Cane of Pacci, Flame Lantern), Four Sword Hurricane Spin Ultimate, and 2 custom Hyrule Pokéball pickup items!

mods.name: National Dex Expansion (Gen 3–9: Hoenn → Paldea)
mods.author: HyruleChosenOne
mods.description: Adds ALL 7 missing Pokémon generations (#252-#1025: Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos, Alola, Galar & Paldea) with 72 custom Gen 3-9 attacks & 24 custom Ultimates, all 419 base families, and all 774 species. Pair with the separate Gen 3-9 Regions & Levels Pack for regional maps. Starts locked by default.

mods.name: Pokémon Soundtrack Audio Pack (HGSS & FRLG)
mods.author: HyruleChosenOne
mods.description: Additive Pokémon music and SFX pack curated from HeartGold/SoulSilver and FireRed/LeafGreen soundtracks (3 menu themes, 8 battle/run themes, 6 legendary/champion boss themes, and 4 iconic SFX). Never replaces vanilla PokéBonk songs.
